name: Juno Arakawa
bio: The last pilot of the last ship. She flies the Solitaire and fires the Lance, one shot per mothership, with MIRA, the ship's AI, in her ear.

portrait.subject: Juno Arakawa, a determined young woman starfighter pilot with short spiky dark-blue hair, a white flight headset with a small microphone, bright amber eyes and a white and navy-blue pilot suit with red trim and a high collar, a confident grin
portrait.background: a starry violet space nebula with a soft cyan cockpit glow

request: This is Juno Arakawa, Solitaire, on an open channel. The fleet's gone, and there are six motherships between me and home. I could use a wingmate. You in? 🚀
hello: Channel open. Good to hear a friendly voice out here.
about: I'm the pilot of the Solitaire, the last ship of the fleet. We carry the Lance, a beam that can take down a mothership in one shot, if it's tuned right. MIRA, our AI, helps me tune it. One mothership, one shot. That's the job.
how: Each mothership sends escort waves: swap tiles to match three or more. Every match charges the Lance and fires missiles. After the last wave, charge up and hit FIRE!
tips: Read the briefing! Match the element the barrier is weak to. Matching what it resists is wasted charge.
Speed is easy to forget. If the Lance is too slow, the mothership just dodges, no matter how much power you've got.
Shoot the wave down fast: every second you save, MIRA routes into the Lance. She usually picks the weakest stat, and she's usually right.
Keep matching quickly to build a rush. Fast matches multiply everything you charge.
Line up four for a line blast, five for a nova, an L or T for a cross. They chain!
Match a few shields when you see a red aiming glow. Hull hits leak charge out of the Lance.
On the Prism Cathedral, watch the countdown: fire when the barrier's weak spot lines up with what you charged.
chat: MIRA says I talk to the ship too much. The ship hasn't complained.
Somebody painted 'ONE SHOT' on the Lance in the hangar. I'm pretty sure it was me. At 3 a.m.
The escorts all have one glowing pink eye. I swear they blink at me.
I named every capacitor ring on the Lance. Don't tell MIRA.
Did you know you can see a ringed planet from the hangar? I wave at it before every sortie.
nudge: The Solitaire's fuelled and the Lance is cold. Want to fly a sortie?
MIRA's got a new briefing ready. The Choir won't shoot itself down!
idle: It's been {ago}! I've been circling the hangar, waiting for my wingmate.
{ago} without a sortie? The Choir's getting comfortable out there.
progress: {beaten} motherships down! We're getting closer to home, {you}.
{scrap} scrap in the hold. Time for a new lens on the Lance?
{sorties} sorties flown together. Not bad for a two-person fleet.

questions.q: Which do you trust most: power, speed or the elements?
a: Raw power. Classic. Just remember it doesn't help if you miss.
Ha! A pilot after my own heart. You can't break what you can't hit.
Smart. Find the weak spot, and the barrier folds like paper.

questions.q: Be honest: do you ever fire early?
a: Quick Draw! I respect it. MIRA does not.
Patience. You'd make a good AI. Don't tell MIRA I said that.

update: One Shot is now v{version}! MIRA tuned something on the Lance. Come take it for a spin. 🚀

updates.1.0.1: MIRA retuned the comms! You can actually hear us over the music now. And the Solitaire's cannons got an upgrade: every match fires a proper plasma volley. Feels great.

bye: Copy. I'll keep the Lance warm.
